title: add pre-install hookdir for oem-config mode, minimal change to ubiquity
commit_message:
add pre-install hookdir for oem-config mode, minimal change to ubiquity
for install automation in hwe development phase.

This works well with dell-recovery and the other recovery that we currently used in oem project.
diff:
diff --git a/bin/ubiquity b/bin/ubiquity
index 9308bf6..ea0e5ac 100755
--- a/bin/ubiquity
+++ b/bin/ubiquity
@@ -465,9 +465,8 @@ def acquire_lock():
             sys.exit(1)
 
 
-def run_oem_hooks():
-    """Run hook scripts from /usr/lib/oem-config/post-install."""
-    hookdir = '/usr/lib/oem-config/post-install'
+def run_oem_hooks(hookdir):
+    """Run hook scripts from hookdir."""
 
     if os.path.isdir(hookdir):
         # Exclude hooks containing '.', so that *.dpkg-* et al are avoided.
@@ -646,13 +645,16 @@ def main(oem_config):
     if oem_config and not options.query:
         disable_autologin()
 
+    if oem_config:
+        run_oem_hooks("/usr/lib/oem-config/pre-install")
+
     if args:
         install(args[0], query=options.query)
     else:
         install(query=options.query)
 
     if oem_config:
-        run_oem_hooks()
+        run_oem_hooks("/usr/lib/oem-config/post-install")
     im_switch.kill_im()
